newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan says World Bank to give $187mln for port.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan says World Bank to give $187mln for port.

text.p: ISLAMABAD, June 10 (Reuter) The World Bank has agreed to lend $187 million to develop Pakistan's Karachi port, a senior Pakistani government official said on Tuesday.

The official APP news agency quoted Communications Ministry secretary Sheikh Inaanmul Haque as saying the loan would be used to prepare the Karachi port for the next century, to compete with other regional ports in attracting regional maritime trade.

Haque, who returned home on Tuesday after talks with World Bank officials in Washington, said the bank appreciated development being made at the Karachi port and "agreed in principle to provide the next loan of $187 million for the improvements of its infrastructure and other facilities".
